newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down at noon on new listing.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down at noon on new listing.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B share index edged down by midday on Thursday as a new listing commanded buying attention and caused investors to turn away from the overall market, brokers said.
Hainan Airlines Co Ltd on Thursday listed 71 million B shares, which soared above the offer price of $0.470 at the open to end the morning at $0.532, up $0.062 or 13.19 percent.
The B share index fell 0.709 points or 0.85 percent to end the morning session at 82.748 points on volume of 17.047 million shares worth $9.503 million.
